info.description: # Overview: Use this document as a quick reference for folders and endpoints. --- ### Setup #### 1\. Get Your API Keys Moyasar provides unique API keys to authenticate API requests. Each account has two pairs of keys — one for **testing** and one for **live** transactions. | Key type | Prefix | Use | | --- | --- | --- | | **Publishable key** | `pk_test_` / `pk_live_` | Creating payments; safe for public use (e.g. HTML forms). | | **Secret key** | `sk_test_` / `sk_live_` | All other API operations. Keep secure; never expose publicly. | - **Test keys:** Use for integration testing without real money. - **Live keys:** Use for real payments (available after account activation). - If you lose a secret key, you must **regenerate** it in the dashboard; you cannot view it again. **→** [Get Your API Keys](https://docs.moyasar.com/guides/dashboard/get-your-api-keys) (Moyasar Dashboard) --- #### 2\. Add Your Values (Use an Environment) Set the following values so the collection can call the API and use callbacks correctly: | Variable | What to set | | --- | --- | | `merchant_base_url` | Base URL of your app (e.g., `https://yourdomain.com`) for callbacks, webhooks, and success/back URLs. | | `apple_domain_name` | Domain registered with Apple Pay for your merchant (only if you use Apple Pay). | | `publishable_api_key` | Your publishable key (`pk_test_xx` or `pk_live_xx`). | | `secret_key` | Your secret key (`sk_test_xx` or `sk_live_xx`). | **Best practice:** Do **not** edit the collection variables. Create a **new Environment** in Postman and define these variables there. That way: - You can switch between test and live by selecting different environments. - Your keys and URLs stay out of the shared collection and are easier to keep secure. - Teammates can use their own environment with their own keys. **In Postman:** Environments → Create Environment → add the variables above → save, then select the environment in the top-right before sending requests.

request.description: Source type: `creditcard`. Required: name (2+ words), number (16-19 digits), month (1-12), year (≥2000), cvc. Optional: statement_descriptor, 3ds (default true), manual (auth-only), save_card. callback_url required for creditcard.
Source type: `token`. Use a previously saved card token (prefix `token_`). Optional: cvc, statement_descriptor, 3ds, manual. callback_url required for token.
Source type: `applepay` with encrypted token from Apple Pay JS/session. Optional: manual, save_card, statement_descriptor. Replace token with payload from PaymentRequest or Apple Pay session.

Source type: `applepay` with decrypted DPAN data. Fields: number (DPAN 16-19 digits), month, year, cryptogram (≤64 chars), device_id (8-16 chars), last_four, eci (2 digits). Optional: manual, save_card, statement_descriptor.
Source type: `samsungpay` with encrypted token from Samsung Pay. Optional: manual, save_card, statement_descriptor. Replace token with payload from Samsung Pay SDK.

Source type: `stcpay`. Required: mobile (Saudi format: 05xxxxxxxx, +9665xxxxxxxx, or 009665xxxxxxxx). Optional: cashier, branch. Response includes transaction_url for OTP challenge; POST otp_value to that URL to complete.

item.description:
## Payments

**Overview:** Create, list, fetch, update, refund, capture, and void payments. Supports multiple payment sources: credit card, saved token, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay, and STC Pay.

| Request | Method | Path | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Create Payment** (subfolder) | — | — | Multiple source types under one folder |
| List Payments | GET | `/payments` | List with filters: page, id, status, created, updated, metadata, card_last_digits, receipt_no |
| Fetch Payment | GET | `/payments/:payment_id` | Get single payment by ID |
| Update Payment | PUT | `/payments/:payment_id` | Update description and/or metadata |
| Refund Payment | POST | `/payments/:payment_id/refund` | Refund (full or partial amount) |
| Capture Payment | POST | `/payments/:payment_id/capture` | Capture authorized payment (e.g. manual auth) |
| Void Payment | POST | `/payments/:payment_id/void` | Void authorized, uncaptured payment |

**Notes:**

- Status filters: `initiated`, `paid`, `authorized`, `failed`, `refunded`, `captured`, `voided`, `verified`.

request.description:
Create a new invoice.

**Required:** `amount` (integer, min 100, in smallest currency unit), `currency` (ISO-4217), `description`.

**Optional:** `callback_url`, `success_url`, `back_url`, `expired_at` (ISO 8601), `metadata` (key-value object).

Returns 201 with the invoice object including `id`, `url` (checkout page), `status`, etc.

Create up to 50 invoices in a single request.

**Body:** `invoices` array; each item has required `amount`, `currency`, `description` and optional `callback_url`, `success_url`, `back_url`, `expired_at`, `metadata`.

request.description:
Generate a token for a Mada or credit card. **Must be called from frontend** with your **publishable key** (pk_test_* / pk_live_*). Use x-www-form-urlencoded body.

Required: name, number (16-19 digits), month (01-12), year (YY or YYYY), cvc, callback_url.

Response includes verification_url for 3DS; cardholder must complete verification for token to become `active`.

**Docs:** https://docs.moyasar.com/api/other/tokens/create-token

Fetch a single token by ID. Uses **secret key** (sk_test_* / sk_live_*). Path param :id is the token ID (e.g. token_x6okRgkZJrhgDHyqJ9zztW2X1k).

**Docs:** https://docs.moyasar.com/api/other/tokens/fetch-token

Delete a token by ID. Uses **secret key** (sk_test_* / sk_live_*). Path param :id is the token ID.

**Docs:** https://docs.moyasar.com/api/other/tokens/delete-token

variable.description: Base URL for Moyasar API endpoints (e.g., `https://api.moyasar.com/v1`). Used to construct all API request URLs.
Base URL of your merchant application. Used in callback URLs, webhook URLs, and redirect URLs (success_url, back_url) so Moyasar can send callbacks and redirects to your application.
Domain name registered with Apple Pay for your merchant account. Required when initiating Apple Pay sessions.
Validation URL provided by Apple Pay session. Used when initiating Apple Pay sessions via the Moyasar API.
Your publishable API key (`pk_test_*` or `pk_live_*`). Used for frontend/public operations like creating tokens. Safe to expose in client-side code.
Your secret API key (`sk_test_*` or `sk_live_*`). Used for server-side operations and authentication via HTTP Basic Auth. Keep secure and never expose publicly.
